commits.message: docs(dropdown): the glyph comment names drawable's resolution, not a switch render owns (rich-render-nmy)

feat(render)!: every glyph a renderable chooses resolves through drawable (rich-render-nmy)

asciiOnly reached only Panel, Table, Rule, Tree and three widgets; ProgressBar,
Spinner, Markdown, Syntax, Viewport, TextInput, the Strip joiners and the
overflow ellipsis ignored it. `drawable` in core/protocol is now the one rule:
a glyph outside ASCII gives way to its stand-in, one already ASCII is kept
(which also stops Rule discarding a caller's `=`). test/renderables/ascii-only
renders every exported renderable under the switch, and needs a row for each.

BREAKING CHANGE: RenderOptions.legacyWindows is removed; nothing read it.

feat(console): asciiOnly reaches renderables through Console, renderToString and App (rich-render-nmy)

RenderOptions.asciiOnly was read by Box.substitute and seven renderables and
set by no public entry point. An ASCII-only terminal is a property of the
output device, so the switch lives where the device is configured:
ConsoleOptions, RenderToStringOptions and AppOptions (WidgetApp inherits it).

RenderOptions.encoding and Console.encoding are removed: nothing read them,
the value was always "utf-8", and it would contradict asciiOnly: true.

test(examples): rich-config full-screen with widgets in a Panel in a Layout pane, proven under both hosts (rich-runtime-fna.6) (#209)

* test(examples): rich-config runs full-screen with its widgets in a Panel in a Layout pane, driven by keys and clicks under both hosts (rich-runtime-fna.6)

The widgets now sit in a "Widgets" panel in the left pane of a row split,
the preview they drive in a panel beside it. union.test.ts drives the demo
over NodeTerminalHost and e2e/rich-config.spec.ts drives the same demo in a
real xterm.js over BrowserTerminalHost: Tab order through the panel, a key
to the focused widget, a click toggling a checkbox, a click-focused text
input, and a dropdown overlay whose option is picked by a click.

* fix(examples): rich-config's preview flows to its pane's width; the tests find cells, not code units (rich-runtime-fna.6)

The swatches, ANSI palette and progress bars were sized for a 100-column
screen, so an 80-column terminal cut the preview pane mid-swatch. They now lay
out through Columns and the pane's maxWidth, like the title panel and palette
search already did.

The tests' click helpers convert a string index to a cell column with cellLen,
the search box is found by what it draws instead of by its offset from the
dropdown, and clickOn loses its unused rowOffset.

fix(table): draw with Table.style and Column's three styles, as the reference does (rich-table-jph)

Table.style is the base the border style layers over; a column's headerStyle and
footerStyle layer over the table's, and its style sits under the row's rowStyles
entry. The cell's style now covers its padding and the blank lines a short cell
runs out of, which is where the reference puts it. Each case is pinned against
Python Rich 9d8f9a3's bytes.
